Hi everyone,

Glad to be here at the start of something awesome.

I'm really passionate about music history. I've already started two subverses for the two things I'm most passionate about: /v/Dancemusichistory /v/Hiphophistory

I was wondering if other people might want to start subverses for the genres they're passionate about? IMO, it's best to keep it rather broad. That's why I chose dancemusichistory instead of starting for instance househistory, technohistory. Most people into one of them will at least be interested in the history of the whole movement (I think).

It would be cool to have a subverse for all the big movements in music history, which could link to each other so people can also find out about other stuff. So if anyone starts one, let me know and I'll add links in the sidebars of the two subverses I'm currently moderating.

I'd be glad to hear your opinion, maybe tips and tricks for content? Right now I'm thinking it's better not to focus on posting tracks, but instead focus on the people and the stories behind the movements.
